name: edrone
description:
edrone is a marketing automation and CRM platform for online stores. This connector lets you explore your edrone account's data directly in Claude, using natural language instead of dashboards and reports.

Once connected, you can ask about:
• Campaigns — newsletters and automations (abandoned cart, welcome, win‑back and more): sent volumes, open and click rates, conversions and attributed revenue.
• Revenue & impact — revenue by channel, by feature and over time, revenue per message, and edrone's contribution to your sales.
• Customers & audiences — subscriber growth, RFM segments, top customers, and customer product interactions.
• Products & orders — best sellers, product performance, order counts and details.
• Onsite, subscriptions & billing — onsite widget performance, subscription reports, SMS/WhatsApp credits and billing details.

How it works:
• Secure sign‑in with your edrone account (OAuth 2.1). You only see data from the store (tracker) you're authorized for.
• The connector works with your existing edrone data to answer questions and produce summaries.
• An account administrator can review connected assistants and revoke or block access at any time.

Who it's for: edrone customers who want faster answers from their marketing and e‑commerce data — without building reports or exporting spreadsheets.

_published_faq.name: How do I add edrone to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add edrone to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.edrone.me/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the edrone MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: edrone lists 75 MCP tools, including count_customers_by_segment, get_active_engagements_count, get_automation_reports, get_billing_details, get_business_summary_audit, get_channel_performance_summary, get_channel_top_kpis, get_customer_activation_metrics, get_customer_product_interactions, get_dashboard_top_kpis, get_edrone_impact, and get_email_deliverability_audit.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to edrone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to edrone in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
edrone requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
edrone is developed by edrone. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
